channel.description: The day's most significant stories, ranked across every section.

item.title: Federal agents raid home of Rep. Ilhan Omar amid immigration investigation
item.description: The raid is the latest escalation in a years-long pattern of scrutiny and rhetorical attacks directed at Omar, the first Somali-American member of Congress, by President Trump and allies in his administration, including past calls for her deportation and allegations of immigration or marital fraud…

item.title: Trump claims 'energy ceasefire' as Russia strikes Ukrainian energy infrastructure
item.description: President Donald Trump announced Sunday that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an immediate "energy ceasefire" halting attacks on each other's energy infrastructure, but Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the claim was "news for me" and reported fresh Russian strikes on Ukrainian energy…

item.title: Meta launches Muse Wonder, its first frontier AI models
item.description: Meta's Superintelligence Lab on Monday released its first frontier AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full. The models are available starting today to Muse Code subscribers, and Wonder can also be accessed through the Meta Model API at $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output…

item.title: Bristol Myers Squibb shares surge 6.5% on positive Phase 3 trial results in neuroendocrine tumors and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
item.description: Bristol Myers Squibb (NYSE: BMY) shares rose 6.5% on Monday after the company announced positive top-line results from two separate Phase 3 clinical trials, one evaluating the radiopharmaceutical therapy RYZ101 for gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors (GEP-NETs) and the other testing the…

item.title: Saudi Arabia vows serious response after deadly Houthi airport attacks
item.description: Saudi Energy Minister Prince Abdul Aziz bin Salman vowed a 'serious' response to recent attacks on the kingdom's airports and oil and gas facilities by Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi movement.
